thesis: Research freedom and accountability mutually require truthful methods, participant protection and institutional support.

ideas.statement: Expertise creates reasons for transparency about plausible consequences, not total authority; distribute dual-use responsibility among decision makers and protect unwelcome results.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Codes do not guarantee behavior; basic research cannot predict exact utility, criticism is not automatically censorship and empirical findings alone do not yield norms.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Codes do not guarantee behavior; basic research cannot predict exact utility, criticism is not automatically censorship and empirical findings alone do not yield norms.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read directly; moral disagreement and finite demands retained.
